justification: ESCALATE. Observed (raw.logs, single event d589173b): svc-backup on db-01, event_type failed_login, 23 failed logins, 47,999,958 bytes_out, 178 processes, src_ip 91.240.118.9, country IR. Isolation Forest = -1 (anomalous); fingerprint z(bytes_out)=348, z(failed_logins)=21.7. Interpretation: pattern is consistent with credential attack followed by possible exfiltration, but all 6 'evidence items' derive from ONE telemetry record - no independent corroboration (no MFA/IdP log, no NetFlow/firewall confirmation, no EDR process list). Uncertainty: XAI confidence 1.0 is just risk_score/100, not a calibrated probability; Meta-AI uncertainty 0.0 and empty issues list is overconfident; login_hour baseline is stale (z=14 on every event today), so fingerprint signal is partly unreliable; a failed_login event carrying 48 MB outbound is internally odd. Policy: risk 100 >= 85 -> RAI recommends isolation WITH human approval; allowed=true is not authorization for autonomous action. Proportionality: isolating db-01 / disabling the backup service account has major operational impact and exceeds a single analyst's authority, so escalate to incident lead/system owner; recommend interim low-impact containment (block 91.240.118.9 at perimeter, force svc-backup credential rotation, heightened monitoring) while corroborating evidence is gathered.

REJECT (likely false positive). Observed (raw.logs): svc-backup on web-01, file_access, src 10.0.0.30 (internal), country US, 1 failed login, 190,994 bytes_out, 33 processes; generator label = normal. Isolation Forest = +1 (NOT anomalous). The ONLY evidence is fingerprint z=14.07, and its z_scores show it comes entirely from login_hour (other features z<1.6). The shipped data/fingerprint_profiles.json was learned at 06:00 UTC (199/200 samples per user); this run is at 07:xx UTC, so every event for every user gets z~14 and risk 80 (33/33 events alerted). The profile never self-corrects because it only learns from events scoring <60. Interpretation: alert reflects a stale baseline, not attacker behaviour. Meta-AI approved with no issues and uncertainty 0.2 - it did not detect the single-feature, single-source basis. Policy: risk 80 -> increase_monitoring, no approval required, so impact is low, but the 100% alert rate causes alert fatigue. Recommendation: reject this alert and ask the detection owner to re-baseline the fingerprint profile (more hours of data) before trusting fingerprint-only alerts.
